text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to rescind the existing parking regulations on the south side of St. Clements Avenue, between Avenue Road and a point 170 metres west, and replace them with a standing prohibition in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. The proposed standing prohibition will promote safe and efficient two-way traffic and enhance the student pick-up/drop-off activity on St. Clements Avenue in the vicinity of Allenby Public School.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing from 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday to Friday on the south side of St. Clements Avenue, between Avenue Road and a point 120 metres west. 2. Rescinded the existing maximum 10-minute parking regulation in effect from 7:30 a.m. to 8:30 a.m. and 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the south side of St. Clements Avenue, between a point 37 metres west of Avenue Road and a point 114 metres west of Avenue Road. 3. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 8:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m., Monday to Friday on the south side of St. Clements Avenue, between a point 37 metres west of Avenue Road and a point 114 metres west of Avenue Road. 4. Rescinded the existing accessible loading zone, in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of St. Clements Avenue, between a point 114 metres west of Avenue Road…
